label: Left Behind: Continuous
description: To what extent do you feel left behind? (0 = "Not at All Left Behind"  to 100 = "Extremely Left Behind")

label: Ideal candidate: Right-wing
description: Mean score of endorsement of right-wing economic platform and cultural platform

label: Ideal candidate: Change
description: Reverse-score of: Thinking about how they would approach change, what approach would you like them to take? 1 = Sweeping (bold, radical changes); 7 = Incremental (smaller, step-by-step changes)

label: Ideal candidate: Experience
description: Thinking about experience with politics, where would your ideal candidate fall? 1 = Outsider (no prior political office); 7 = Insider (many years in political office)

label: Social Mobility Belief
description: Mean score of social mobility scale

label: Social Connectedness
description: Mean score of social connectedness scale

label: Left Behind: Race
description: Cooley et al's measure: randking of the self, compared to four racial groups (1 = first place; 5 = last place)
